open_work:
Six receiving chassis still need their period furniture. The separately fitted tubs, wringer, irons and airers remain passive; operating services, tickets, rear workshop access and whole-building acceptance remain open. This local table fit grants no service capacity, continuous route or human acceptance.
Forty parcel ties seat their outer radius on the shelf instead of dipping 1.2mm through it. The ironing pad south edge stops 30mm short of its old outline to clear the closed door case; its supporting table and working height stay fixed.
